name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes friends' titles that never start in a browser (the player keeps loading, the friend sees a viewer at 0:00) when a web server in front of Jellyfin sends broken headers. Your server now checks each friend's server and its own web page for the usual reverse-proxy mistakes: Access-Control-Allow-Origin sent twice, as a list or for the wrong site, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy blocking your site, and a Content-Security-Policy or Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy on your own server that leaves friends out. When converted video would be blocked, browsers get it converted on your server instead; every problem is named once in the plugin's Log tab with what to change. Includes everything in 0.0.200.
